acceptedAnswer.text: It varies greatly. Local moves are usually priced by the hour, while long-distance moves are priced by weight and distance. Use this tool for a planning figure, then get written quotes.

mainEntity.name: Is a container or a truck cheaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: For long distances, a rental truck is usually the cheapest but you do the driving and lifting. Containers fall in the middle, and full-service movers cost the most but do the work. The comparison panel uses your assumptions.

mainEntity.name: How is a long-distance move priced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interstate moves are priced by the weight of your goods and the distance, plus services such as packing. Movers weigh the truck before and after loading.
It is the basic, no-extra-cost liability. It pays 60 cents per pound per item, so it does not cover the true value of most belongings. Full value protection costs extra but pays to repair or replace.

mainEntity.name: How can I lower my moving costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Declutter before you move, move in the off-season and mid-month, pack yourself, and compare quotes. Less weight and fewer services directly reduce a long-distance bill.
